identity: A long page with a sticky header, sections below the fold, and links, tools, fields, or scrollable content that the visitor must find and use.

scenarios.name: link
scenarios.screen: The page starts at the top, showing its title, opening text, and sticky header. About six sections continue below the fold, with links or buttons inside them; none has been clicked.
never: A linked page open with a Back button.
A lower-section action already marked as opened.
All lower sections visible in the first viewport.

arrangements.text: The sections run down the page, with each section's actions beneath its paragraphs.
A table of contents sits before the sections, and its links point to headings farther down the page.

scenarios.name: accordion
scenarios.screen: The page starts at the top with introductory sections under the sticky header. A FAQ block of about nine questions sits farther down; its answers are closed and their links are hidden.
never: The target answer open on load.
A link inside a closed answer visible.
A linked page open with a Back button.

arrangements.text: The FAQ questions form one vertical list after the introductory sections.
The FAQ list sits between prose sections, with more page content below it.

scenarios.name: copy
scenarios.screen: The page starts at the top under its sticky header. An empty labeled field is near the top and the requested code is printed in a later section, alongside other labeled codes elsewhere on the page.
never: The field already filled with the requested code.
A code picker or clipboard popup open.
All printed codes gathered beside the field.

arrangements.text: The empty field sits near the start of the page, and the printed value sits in a section farther down.
The printed value sits near the start of the page, and the empty field sits near the end.

scenarios.name: top
scenarios.screen: The page starts at the bottom, showing the final content and a toolbar with actions whose labels repeat in the sticky header. A floating Back to top button is visible; no tool has been clicked.
never: The page positioned at its opening section.
A header tool already marked as opened.
A tool menu or share dialog open.
A linked page open with a Back button.

arrangements.text: The header tools sit across the sticky header, while the matching bottom toolbar sits after the final section.
A table of contents sits near the beginning of the page, above the sections; the matching toolbar remains below the final section.

scenarios.name: nested
scenarios.screen: The page starts at the top, with the titled scroll pane in a section below the fold. The pane contains about twelve rows with actions; its target row has not been brought into view.
never: The pane open as a popup.
Rows already outside the pane.
The target row's action already marked as opened.

arrangements.text: One vertical scroll pane sits below its host section heading, with rows stacked inside it.
The host section contains groups, each with its own vertical scroll pane beneath the group title.

scenarios.name: hscroll
scenarios.screen: The page starts at the top, with a Help articles section farther down. Its horizontal card strip contains about twenty cards, and the target card is beyond the strip's initial view to the right.
never: The card strip open as a popup.
All cards visible at once.
Cards already outside the strip.
The target card's Open action already marked as opened.

arrangements.text: The cards sit in one horizontal strip beneath the host section heading, with a horizontal scrollbar along the strip.
A table of contents appears before the page sections, and the horizontal card strip sits inside a later section.

scenarios.name: carousel
scenarios.screen: The page starts at the top, with a Help articles section below the fold. Its carousel contains about twenty slides, shows its initial slide, and has previous and next controls; the target slide is farther along.
never: All slides visible side by side.
The target slide selected on load.
A slide open as a separate popup.
The target slide's Open action already marked as opened.

arrangements.text: One slide occupies the carousel beneath the host section heading, with previous and next arrows at its sides.
The carousel sits between earlier and later page sections, with its slides moving horizontally within the host section.

scenarios.name: sticky
scenarios.screen: The page starts at the top, with a table in a section below the fold. The table has about twelve rows with actions and a header row that stays at the top of its own scroll pane.
never: The table header floating over the whole page.
Rows already outside the table pane.
A partly covered row counted as fully visible.
The target row's Open action already marked as opened.

arrangements.text: The table sits beneath its section heading, with the header row above the vertically stacked data rows.
A table of contents precedes the page sections, while the scrollable table remains inside a later section.

scenarios.name: lazy
scenarios.screen: The page starts at the top, with a scrollable list in a section below the fold. Only its initial batch of rows is loaded; later rows, including the target, are absent until the list is scrolled to its end.
never: Every list row present on load.
A timer-driven loading dialog open.
The target row visible before its batch loads.
Rows already outside the list pane.

arrangements.text: The loaded rows form a vertical list beneath the host section heading, inside one scroll pane.
The list sits in a later page section reached from a table of contents near the top.

scenarios.name: siblings
scenarios.screen: The page starts at the top, with two titled scroll panes side by side in a section below the fold. Each pane has rows with actions, but only one contains the target row; neither pane has been scrolled to it.
never: The two lists stacked into one pane.
A row moved from one pane into the other.
The target action already marked as opened.
Either pane open as a popup.

arrangements.text: Two titled vertical lists sit side by side beneath the host section heading, with the target list on the right.
The same two titled lists sit side by side, with the target list on the left.
